origin: Self-trained in kilix-lander's own simulation (tools/neural/lander_lab.c linked against game.o). No third-party data or weights.
outputs: 6 logits: main thrust {off,on} x side {none,left,right}; argmax each tick

training.method: evolution strategies (antithetic, rank-shaped, Adam, sigma 0.05, lr 0.02, pop 96, 96 shared levels per generation) optimising the landing outcome directly; no teacher
stages: from scratch, 600 generations, levels 1-12, random terminal sizes 640x400-3840x2160 (selected at generation 420)
continued 500 generations on levels 1-60 (selected at generation 440)

selection.rule: highest selection landing rate; ties go to the smaller network

held_out.ship_rule: beat the autopilot overall with non-overlapping Wilson intervals and be no worse on any difficulty: met
